spanish: Y dijo a él Jehová: Anda, desciende, y subirás tú y Aarón contigo, y los sacerdotes y el pueblo no irrumpan a subir a Jehová, no sea que prorrumpa en ellos.

findings.issue: irrumpan renders H2040 (tear down, demolish) as bursting in or forcing entry, a concept the lemma does not license

notes: Other tokens match in person, number, and participants; prorrumpa stays within H6555 as breaking forth.
